title: Listening · Mindset L1 · Lesson 52 · James & Marilyn's Stories
description: Nghe 2 đoạn audio về câu chuyện của James và Marilyn, sau đó điền từ vào chỗ trống dựa trên nội dung nghe được.

parts.name: Phần 1 · Câu chuyện của James
parts.hint: Nghe audio và điền đúng một từ vào mỗi chỗ trống trong đoạn văn bên dưới.

questions.q: Nghe audio và điền vào đoạn script bên dưới:
questions.text: Well, I can remember one ____terrible____ thing I did to my brother when we were ____teenagers____. I have a twin brother. Um, so we used to ____fight____ and ____argue____ a lot, as kids and teenagers. And one time, when we were about ____fifteen____, we were fighting, arguing. We shared a bedroom, so we were in our room, um, fighting each other, and I accidentally ____stabbed____ him in the finger with a ____penknife____ that I was holding in my hand. And it was a total ____accident____, and I was holding it and I was kind of ____threatening____ him, but I didn't really mean to stab him, obviously, um, but I did, and I was absolutely ____horrified____ at what I'd done. And of course, he – my brother – he looked down at his finger, with this blood ____coming____ out from where I'd stabbed him, and he looked up at me, and he said, 'I'm going to ____tell____ Mum!', which sort of made me laugh because, you know, we were both fifteen at the time, and it was a very ____childish____ thing to say. And he ran downstairs to tell our mum, and I was absolutely ____terrified____ that she was going to be really angry with me. Which she was, of course. But, um, he was fine, by the way – it was a very ____small____ ____cut____. He didn't have to go to hospital or anything; it was absolutely fine, but, um, he still now – and this is, you know, we're in our late forties now, so this is thirty years ago – but he still sometimes tells people, when we meet them, about when I stabbed him.

parts.name: Phần 2 · Câu chuyện của Marilyn
parts.hint: Tiếp tục nghe và điền đúng một từ vào mỗi chỗ trống trong đoạn văn bên dưới.

questions.q: Nghe audio và điền vào đoạn script bên dưới:
questions.text: Well, my ____sister____ was four years older than me. She still is, actually. Um, I remember once when I was about ten years old, I had a ____pet____, a bird. Um, it was a small green ____parrot____ called Charlie, and I really loved him. He lived in a ____cage____, but I sometimes let him out to fly around the house, you know, so he could have some ____freedom____. And one day, I was in my bedroom and I let him out, but then something happened – I can't remember what – and I ____forgot____ about him for a while, and then suddenly I couldn't see him anymore. And, well, I looked ____everywhere____ for him – I looked all over the house and I couldn't find him anywhere. Oh, I ____cried____ and I cried because I was sure that he had ____flown____ out of the window. And my ____parents____ started to help me because they felt awful about it as well. And just when I was completely ____hysterical____, my sister admitted that, in reality, she had ____hidden____ him: she had shut him inside a ____cupboard____ – can you believe? Well, she opened the cupboard and poor Charlie was there; he was so ____frightened____, but we were all really ____relieved____ to find him. My sister was so horrible that day. Of course, now we get on really well, but I still remember what she did to poor Charlie, and sometimes when she comes to see me, I hide her car ____keys____ or her purse or something just to remind her of it. Is that bad?
